newsitem.title: USA: Lucas Aerospace to buy Boeing unit.
newsitem.headline: Lucas Aerospace to buy Boeing unit.

text.p: LucasVarity said on Monday that it would acquire a unit of Boeing Co that manufactured cargo handling systems for an undisclosed sum.
The companies said in a joint statement that Lucas Aerospace would acquire the assets of Boeing Georgia Inc, which also made other components for commercial aircraft.

Lucas Aerospace's annual sales would increase about $90 million and it would obtain rights to manufacture, sell and distibute 746, 767 and 777 cargo systems spares directly to airlines and freight carriers, the companies said.
In a separate agreement, Lucas said it would get a multi-year requirements order for contracted hardware.

"This is an important acquisition in line with Lucas Aerospace's strategy of reinforcing and strengthening the position of our core businesses in the marketplace," Ken Maciver, aerospace divisional managing director for LucasVarity said in a statement.
Lucas Aerospace Cargo has supplied cargo systems, components and aerostructures to Boeing for 25 years.
